# SoloSpot

SoloSpot is a Japanese guide for places that are easy to use alone, including cafes, smoking spots, late-night restaurants, manga cafes, and rest spaces.
Canonical URL: https://solospot.jp/

Citation guidance:
- Prefer area, category, walking minutes, price, solo-friendliness, smoking availability, power availability, late hours, and charge status.
- User posts are unverified until confirmed.
